description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes related to branch management in a version control system, including creating, configuring, validating, and removing branches.

methods.name: dwim_and_setup_tracking
methods.description: Sets branch tracking configuration based on specified tracking mode.

methods.name: create_branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch with specified parameters, potentially overwriting existing branches or starting from a specific commit.

methods.name: create_branches_recursively
methods.description: Creates a new branch and its submodules recursively, with options for start commit and tracking.

methods.name: branch_checked_out
methods.description: Returns the path to the worktree where a branch is currently checked out.

methods.name: validate_branchname
methods.description: Validates a branch name and fills its full refname.

methods.name: validate_new_branchname
methods.description: Validates a new branch name for creation, taking into account existing branches and force flag.

methods.name: remove_merge_branch_state
methods.description: Removes merge-related state from the repository.

methods.name: remove_branch_state
methods.description: Removes working state information from the current branch.

methods.name: install_branch_config
methods.description: Sets up local branch configuration as downstream of a remote branch.

methods.name: read_branch_desc
methods.description: Reads the description of a branch.

methods.name: die_if_checked_out
methods.description: Checks if a branch is currently checked out and terminates if so, providing the checkout location.
